Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring prompt issuance of change orders for additional work on public works projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prompt issuance of change orders for additionalwork on public works projects; and adding a new section to chapter39.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If the public body and the general contractor agree, in writing, ona price for additional work, the public body must issue a change orderwithin sixty days of the written agreement. If the public body doesnot issue a change order within the sixty days, interest shall accrueon the dollar amount of the additional work satisfactorily completeduntil a change order is issued. The public body shall pay thisinterest at a rate of one percent per month. No interest may accrue ona change order that is timely issued under this section. The generalcontractor shall present a fully documented pay request for additionalwork that is satisfactorily completed under a change order executedbetween the public body and the general contractor. Payment of a fully p. 1 SSB 5399documented pay request must then be made by the public body inaccordance with chapter 39.76 RCW.
